text:
Priya: Heads up 1: multiple evals from yesterday's onsite are showing zeros in the aggregate dashboard despite interviewers reporting they completed scorecards. Noticed after the nightly aggregator run.

Marco: hmm. which candidates? any common template?

Priya: C-5432, C-5439, C-5440. All used the new rubric we rolled out yesterday (template id: rubric-v3). Recruiters say interviewers submitted via the web form.

Sam: looked at raw submissions 1: payloads landed but fields are named `score_overall_v3` whereas aggregator expects `score_overall`. here's a sample: 

```
{
  "candidate_id": "C-5432",
  "submitted_by": "interviewer@redwood.com",
  "template_id": "rubric-v3",
  "answers": {
    "score_overall_v3": 4,
    "culture_fit_v3": 5
  }
}
```

Rhea: oh no. template migration script was supposed to write compatibility aliases. did the migration fail?

Marco: I deployed the template change at 02:10, migration job kicked off but it errored on timeout for large panels. Logs show retries then exit.

Priya: Ops perspective: recruiters are getting candidate questions and interviewers are upset that scores "vanished". We need to restore visibility ASAP and stop further missing aggregates.

Sam: quick mitigation: modify aggregator to accept both suffix versions and fallback to normalized keys. I'll open a PR to map `*_v3` -> `*`.

Marco: agree, do the aggregator change first (fast rollback-safe). After that we can re-run aggregation on last 48h.

Rhea: For long-term: fix migration job and add post-migration verification step that checks for alias fields in submissions. Also add a deploy checklist item for template upgrades.

Priya: Also please notify interviewers & recruiters about the incident and that existing submissions are safe. Can we auto-generate a short note?

ops-bot: Suggested message draft: "We observed a template version mismatch affecting score visibility earlier today. Your submissions were recorded; we're restoring visibility and will follow up when re-aggregation completes. Sorry for the confusion." Use :warning: if you want to escalate.

Priya: Looks good. Marco, timeline?

Marco: I'll patch aggregator within 30m, run re-agg (couple hours), migration fix EOD. Posting PR link when ready.

Sam: I'll run re-agg once patch is merged and monitor dashboard for recovered numbers.

Rhea: I'll send the note to recruiters and pop into #interviews to explain for affected panels.

Priya: thanks team. Action items: Marco (agg patch + migration fix), Sam (re-agg + monitor), Rhea (comms), Priya (follow-up with hiring managers). Reopen thread if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
